clue.text: I'm in laced up number-French original!

indicators.note: in tells us the first piece is set inside the jumbled second piece
laced up suggests the letters of laced are tied up in a new arrangement

parts.note: I'm gives its letters IM, the apostrophe dropped

explanation.surface: Someone boasts of a tightly laced dance number with a French origin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns LACED into DECAL, and 'in' puts IM inside it after DEC.
explanation.definitionFit: A decimal is a kind of number, and the word comes to English by way of French décimal.

clue.text: Prepared a skeleton to be drummed into service

definitions.meaning: to draw up the outline of a document is to prepare its skeleton
conscripted into the armed forces

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: an outline version of a text, and compulsory call-up to military service.

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a business
a firm is a company, abbreviated CO
nut is slang for the head

explanation.surface: A fruit company trading under a strong chief.
explanation.definitionFit: The coconut is the large hard-shelled fruit of the coconut palm.

parts.note: read as rock bands at the top of their game, but literally masses of rock rising to summits

explanation.definitionFit: Ranges of high land are literally great groups of rock shaped into peaks.

definitions.meaning: a brood of young animals, such as kids, born at one time
straw bedding for animals, or a stretcher-like couch carried by bearers

explanation.definitionFit: A litter is a set of young born together, and also a bed carried on poles or straw bedding.

parts.note: MA is an informal word for mother
to shy is to throw, so throws gives SHIES

explanation.surface: Mum hurls the golf clubs in a temper.
explanation.definitionFit: A mashie was an old iron-headed golf club, roughly a modern five iron.

clue.text: Miss Fox upset by quarrel with lover-the brute!

indicators.note: in a down clue upset turns the name upside down, so it reads from bottom to top

parts.note: Sam Fox, the 1980s British pin-up and pop singer
a lovers' tiff is a small quarrel

explanation.surface: A tabloid tale of a celebrity distressed by a row with her boyfriend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns SAM into MAS; Samantha Fox was a famous British glamour model and singer.
explanation.definitionFit: A mastiff is a huge powerful dog breed, so a brute in the sense of an animal.

definitions.meaning: to move or alter something
a simple loose dress or undergarment

explanation.definitionFit: Shift means to alter position, and a shift is also a straight-cut dress or slip.

parts.note: looks like a turning off a road, but means the period when one cricket team bats

explanation.definitionFit: In cricket each team's spell of batting is its turn at the crease.

definitions.meaning: belonging to the county south of London
light four-wheeled horse carriages

explanation.walkthrough: SURREY is a county in southern England; a surrey is also an American pleasure carriage.
explanation.definitionFit: The county name with possessive, and the plural of a carriage named after that county.

parts.note: reads as parliamentary procedure, but combines a bill to be paid and a report or narrative

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both an invoice to be settled and a narrative report of events.

definitions.meaning: a lure used in fishing that revolves in the water
the spinning jenny, an early machine for spinning yarn

explanation.definitionFit: A fishing lure that rotates, and a machine that spins thread, like Hargreaves's jenny.

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A belief held by an ancient African people now lost to memory.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenet is a principle or belief held as true, which is what a doctrine is.

indicators.note: converted says the letters are changed into a new form

parts.note: CE stands for Church of England

explanation.surface: Sixteen people converted and devoted their lives to the church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'converted' turns SIXTEEN into EXISTEN, then CE completes it.
explanation.definitionFit: Existence is being alive, a synonym for life.

clue.text: Truncates minor parts of the plan

definitions.meaning: cuts the tails off, read as removing tails
small particulars of a scheme

explanation.definitionFit: Read as DE-TAILS it means docks the tails; as a noun it means fine particulars.

clue.text: Golfer's warnings on the way to reverse woods

parts.note: golfers shout fore to warn of an incoming ball

indicators.note: to reverse tells us to read the abbreviation for way backwards

parts.note: ST is short for street, a way

explanation.surface: A golfer shouts warnings while driving off towards the trees.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to reverse' turns ST into TS after FORES.
explanation.definitionFit: Forests are large expanses of trees, the same as woods.

clue.text: How we can mend our ways

definitions.text: How we can mend our ways

parts.words: How we can mend our ways
parts.note: reads as moral reform, but describes repairs being made to roads

explanation.definitionFit: Repairs to a road surface literally mend the ways we travel on.

clue.text: Mugs past working when testing time comes

definitions.text: Mugs past working when testing time comes

parts.words: Mugs past working when testing time comes
parts.note: mugs up means studies hard, and a student does so over past work when exams approach

explanation.definitionFit: Going back over earlier material before an exam is swotting, or mugging up.

parts.note: RE means about or concerning
signs are portents or omens

explanation.surface: A minister quits after reading the omens.
explanation.definitionFit: To resign is to give up a job or post, so to abandon a position.

clue.text: One who would like to play "Red River" on his mouth organ?

definitions.text: One who would like to play "Red River" on his mouth organ?

parts.words: One who would like to play "Red River" on his mouth organ?
parts.note: sounds like a harmonica player and a tune, but a red river is a flow of blood at the mouth

explanation.definitionFit: A creature of legend that drinks blood, which would flow red over its mouth.

definitions.meaning: relies on others' generosity, a freeloader's way
light airy cakes such as the Victoria type

explanation.definitionFit: To sponge is to cadge a living from others, and sponges are light cakes.

definitions.meaning: lots drawn are matters of luck or fortune
openings to do something

explanation.definitionFit: Taking one's chances is accepting one's lot, and a chance is an opening.

definitions.meaning: brought into being
British informal: to create is to make a fuss in anger

explanation.walkthrough: In British slang to 'create' is to make an angry scene.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring into being, and the informal British sense of kicking up a fuss.

clue.text: Give Kitty a ring, and moan about her performance

definitions.meaning: read as phone a cat, a call to a kitty
a shrill jeer of disapproval at a show

explanation.definitionFit: A whistle of derision at a performer, which also splits as a phone call to a cat.

parts.note: suggests restaurant staff, but means patients waiting with ailments at the doctor's

explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a doctor's surgery is the GP's consulting room, where patients wait.
explanation.definitionFit: A British doctor's practice where people with ailments wait to be seen.

clue.text: Standard English as taught by the Navy

definitions.text: Standard English as taught by the Navy

parts.words: Standard English as taught by the Navy
parts.note: seems to be about correct speech, but standard means a flag, used to spell out messages

explanation.definitionFit: A signalling system using flags held in positions to stand for letters.

parts.note: prim means stiffly proper
E for East, Oriental

explanation.surface: A stiff, formal leader from the East.
explanation.definitionFit: Prime means first in importance, the same as chief.

clue.text: I leave restaurant worker a drink

indicators.note: leave says the letter named is removed from the worker

parts.note: a waiter serves in a restaurant

explanation.surface: A customer departs, leaving the waiter a drink as a tip.
explanation.definitionFit: Water is the basic drink, a glass of the clear stuff.

clue.text: Having a moan about case being at home, goes to Gates head

parts.note: a grip is a holdall or travelling bag
in means at home

indicators.note: head picks the first letter of Gates

explanation.surface: Someone moaning about luggage at home before heading off to Gateshead.
explanation.walkthrough: Gateshead is a town in north-east England, split here as Gates head.
explanation.definitionFit: Griping is complaining, having a moan.

clue.text: Some stand in a row of houses

definitions.meaning: the standing area at a football ground
a line of joined houses

explanation.walkthrough: British football grounds had standing terraces for fans.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: a stepped standing area for spectators and a row of joined houses.

indicators.note: novel means new, so the letters are made new

parts.note: the playwright Arnold Wesker, possessive kept as a letter

explanation.surface: A thriller by the playwright Wesker titled Joint Security.
explanation.definitionFit: Spits pushed through meat hold a roast joint secure while cooking.

clue.text: Hell of a theatrical production or show?

parts.note: Dis is the Roman underworld, hell
a play is a theatrical production

explanation.surface: Was it an infernal play or just a show?
explanation.definitionFit: A display is an exhibition, a show.
